Control Activity: MFA and least-privilege roles are reviewed
Privileged roles are separately identified and recertified
Private data tiers and restricted security groups are used
Organization CloudTrail is enabled and centralized
Threat detection findings are routed for investigation
Encryption at rest and TLS in transit are required
Key policies and rotation are configured
Cloud workloads are scanned and remediation SLAs tracked
Critical services are covered by managed backups
Critical workloads undergo documented restore tests
CSPM/baseline checks monitor public access and weak configurations
Cloud incident playbook defines triage and evidence preservation
Provider assurance is mapped to customer obligations
Data stores have classification ownership and retention
Changes require approval testing and rollback evidence
